name: Get email campaign
description: Call this when you have an internal email campaign id and need that one campaign's full editor-level record — its status (e.g. Draft), type, name, creation and modification timestamps, scheduling and unsubscribe-page flags, and the internal object/template references the web editor uses. Use this before deciding whether a campaign can still be edited or scheduled, and to resolve a campaign id into its current state. For a list of campaigns to pick an id from, use the campaigns listing action instead; for the public, documented campaign representation (including recipients and statistics as the public API models them), prefer the public GET /v3/emailCampaigns/{campaignId} operation — this web-app endpoint returns editor-internal fields that the public API does not expose and that may change without notice.
preconditions: The campaign must already exist and be visible to the authenticated account.
The caller must be an authenticated session of the account that owns the campaign (this is a web-app endpoint, not the public API-key surface).

id.description: Internal numeric id of the email campaign, taken from the path (e.g. 3). This is the web app's campaign id, not an object id or a public API campaign id guaranteed to match.
Internal numeric campaign id, matching the id in the path.

camp_name.description: Campaign name shown in the UI.

campaign_type.description: Campaign family as reported by the web app, e.g. "regular".

type.description: Editor/content type of the campaign, e.g. "classic".

status.description: Current lifecycle status as a display string, e.g. "Draft".

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset for when the campaign was created.

modified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset for the last modification.

objectId.description: Internal object identifier for the campaign document.

is_ax_testing.description: Whether the campaign is set up as an A/X test.

delay.description: Whether a send delay is configured.

unsubscribePageAdded.description: Whether an unsubscribe page has been attached.

auto_unsubscribe_page_added.description: Whether the unsubscribe page was added automatically.

list_and_segment_combined.description: Whether recipients are expressed as a combined list-and-segment selection.

ashtml.description: Flag for whether the campaign is handled as raw HTML.

was_subject_modified_after_use.description: Whether the subject line changed after it was already used.

thumblink_outdated.description: Whether the stored thumbnail preview is stale.

ga_active.description: Whether Google Analytics tracking is enabled.

utm_id_active.description: Whether UTM id tagging is enabled.

mirror_active.description: Whether the web-mirror version of the email is enabled.

updated_ip.description: IP address recorded at the last update.
